description: This file defines the Toolbar React component for a Kanban board application. It provides controls for uploading and exporting cards, managing columns, toggling fullscreen mode, and other board actions.

methods.name: downloadExcelTemplate()
methods.description: Generates and downloads an Excel template file for Kanban cards with predefined columns.

methods.name: handleAddColumn
methods.description: Displays the modal to add a new column.

methods.name: handleAddColumnSubmit
methods.description: Handles submission of the new column form, adding the column to the kanban board.

methods.name: handleExcelUpload
methods.description: Processes uploaded Excel file, reads its data, and prompts for bulk upload options.

methods.name: handleConfirmBulkUpload
methods.description: Converts Excel rows into card objects and inserts them into a specified column.

methods.name: handleExportCardsCsv
methods.description: Exports current cards as a CSV file and triggers download.

methods.name: handleCsvFileSelected
methods.description: Reads uploaded CSV, provides a preview, and initiates sync confirmation.

methods.name: handleConfirmCsvSync
methods.description: Performs CSV synchronization, updating existing cards or inserting new ones based on CSV data.

methods.name: Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })

ctags.name: Toolbar
ctags.pattern: /^function Toolbar({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true }) {$/
ctags.signature: ({ onToggleFullscreen, isFullscreen, crOnly, onToggleCrOnly, canEdit = true })
